怎么切换英文 / 繁体字 / 韩文？: How do I switch to English / Traditional Chinese / Korean?
点右上角的 🌐 小按钮，里面有「简体 / 繁體 / English / 한국어」: Tap the 🌐 button at the top right. It has “简体 / 繁體 / English / 한국어” — tap one to switch, and your choice is remembered next time. The default is Simplified Chinese.
